MAJOR: removing or renaming a reusable workflow, composite action, input, secret or output; making an optional input required; changing a default so existing callers behave differently; renaming a job, check or workflow name that callers or rulesets depend on (Build and test, Review with Claude, label-gate, Classify PR, Label Gate); requiring a permission that callers do not already grant.

MINOR: a new reusable workflow, composite action, or optional input or output with a safe default.

PATCH: bug fixes, documentation, dependency and action version bumps, and internal refactors with no change visible to callers.
